name: When You Were Mine
source:
"It's time to move on."

When You Were Mine is a choiceless visual novel that follows the brief reunion of a pair of ex-lovers after five years have passed. It is a short exploration of the dependency love can turn into when fueled by uncertainty and loneliness.

[From [url=https://zid-the-red-panda.itch.io/when-you-were-mine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“是时候继续前进了。”

《当你是我的时候》是一部无选择的视觉小说，讲述了一对前恋人五年后短暂重逢的故事。这是对爱情在不确定和孤独的推动下可能变成的依赖的简短探索。

[来自[url=https://zid-the-red-panda.itch.io/when-you-were-mine]Itch.io[/url]]
